newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRENCH LEAGUE MATCHES THIS WEEK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH LEAGUE MATCHES THIS WEEK.

text.p: French soccer league matches this week (kickoff times GMT, standings in parentheses):

Now second, seven points behind leaders Monaco, Paris St Germain must win if they want to stay in contention for the title. Lens will welcome back Czech striker Vladimir Smicer, who was out of action because of a fractured nose.

A potentially exciting clash between Nantes, the 1995 champions, and holders Auxerre. Nantes recovered after a poor start to the season and have not lost in their last 18 matches. Auxerre will be without defender Franck Rabarivony and striker Steve Marlet, who are both injured.
Leaders Monaco must beware of lowly Le Havre, who badly need points to avoid relegation.
A rematch of a disputed French Cup, first-round tie won 1-0 by Lille last week. Marseille will seek revenge but will be without Hamada Jambay, Chris Makin and Ivan Franceschini, all suspended.
Strasbourg look stronger but bottom club Nice recovered some pride by knocking out Bastia in a French Cup, second-round match last Friday and will look for another win.
Bastia want to make up for their elimination in the French Cup and Caen need points if they want to stay in the first division.
Rennes will count on Stephane Guivar'ch, the league's top scorer with 17 goals, fully fit after an injury break.
Cannes are doing surprisingly well with limited resources while Lyon are one of the great disappointments of the season.
Bordeaux, who want to buy Auxerre striker Lilian Laslandes, need a good result to stay in the chase for a place in Europe.
Montpellier are in a difficult situation but their win over Metz in the French Cup last weekend did their confidence a lot of good.
